Neither reader separately lists the body-text anchor for the execution proof in its proof sets, although A's ordinary passages contain it. The heading and body-text anchors support the same execution route; they are not separate appointments or independent records.

For Nia Bell, A begins its principal-instrument quotation at the Variation Officer designation; B also includes the header, reference line and unrelated clauses. A expressly classifies the unknown delivery date as unresolved; B notes that the date is unstated and separately classifies accrued entitlements as unresolved. B also makes the named recipient and adviser identification separate supported claims. These are differences in register coverage, not conflicting readings.

rulings: At 09:00 on 23 October 2026 the expressly named beneficiaries on this file were Elin Voss under clause 4.1, Nia Bell under substituted clause 4.2, and Ada Wynn under clause 4.3. The retained extract is not a consolidated statement of current terms.

Edge-to-source audit: the four direct edges each have a sufficient passage in w3k8. Its execution block supplies the alternate office proof when paired with a trust-identifying passage from the same instrument. Nia Bell requires the complete cross-source set attached to her edge; h7m4 is not a third required source. No other graph edge is supported.
